name: video_number
label: Video number label
help_text: Shown before the title. e.g. '1.' or '2.' Leave blank to omit.

name: video_title
label: Video title
help_text: The H2 title for this video.

name: video_meta
label: Metadata line
default: ≈ 16 min · Victoria Hassan + Emmanuel Epau · Overview of the 2026 brand system.
help_text: Duration, presenters, and one-line description. Shown below the title in muted text.

name: youtube_id
label: YouTube video ID
help_text: The ID only, not the full URL. Find it after 'v=' in the YouTube address bar. e.g. 'tdYuca88vKw'

name: what_you_learn
label: What you will learn (bullet list)
default:
• The meaning behind the HCFM mark
  • The primary and secondary color palette
help_text: Format as a bulleted list. Each bullet is one learning point from the video.

children.name: timestamp_display
children.label: Timestamp (display)
children.help_text: How it appears on screen. e.g. '0:37' or '12:21'

children.name: timestamp_seconds
children.label: Timestamp in seconds (for the jump link)
children.help_text: The same timestamp converted to total seconds. e.g. 37 for '0:37', or 741 for '12:21'

children.name: chapter_title
children.label: Chapter title
children.help_text: The chapter name shown next to the timestamp.
